instagram.caption:
This sum looks messy. It isn't.

1/(1·2) + 1/(2·3) + … + 1/(9·10) = ?

You have 40 seconds. Drop your answer below.
instagram.first_comment:
Answer: 9/10

The trick: write each term as 1/k − 1/(k+1). The middle terms all cancel and you're left with 1 − 1/10.

What did you get?
